title: animations.json
description: Animation frame timeline for one entity, stored at Entities/<Entity Name>/animations.json. Deserialized as Sor2NewEra.Gameplay.AnimationsSetData. The array index of each animation is its animation id; see the Enums and Identifiers reference for the Classic animation slot table.

animations.description: One entry per animation slot. Index i is animation id i, which equals the Classic AnimationId value divided by two. Entries may be null to leave a slot empty; never reorder the array to rename an animation.

name.description: Editor label for this animation. Purely cosmetic: the runtime addresses animations by index. The Character Editor mirrors this value into logic.json animationsLogic[i].name on save.

frames.description: Ordered frames. The animation's total length in game frames is the sum of every frame duration, and that total is what event and box frame numbers are measured against.

referenceTotalFrames.description: Total frame count of the same animation on the reference entity. Used by the editor to keep a Classic reskin aligned with the original timing; leave at 0 when there is no reference.

TotalFrames.description: Computed property written by older builds of the tools. The runtime ignores it; do not write it in new files. It is the sum of the frame durations.

duration.description: How many game frames this image is held for. The game runs at 60 frames per second.

imageId.description: Effective sprite index. Indexes the combined frame list: borrowed reference frames occupy indices 0..R-1, and this entity's own frames follow at R..R+N-1, where own frame k is the file <k>.png. A negative value draws nothing.

weapon.description: Optional weapon overlay drawn on this frame.

useReferenceArt.description: Editor artifact from an older sprite-reference model. Whether a frame uses reference art is now derived from imageId falling below the reference frame count.

direction.description: WeaponAngle: 0 Up, 1 UpLeft, 2 Left, 3 DownLeft, 4 Down, 5 DownRight, 6 Right, 7 UpRight.

showBehind.description: Draw the weapon behind the character instead of in front.

position.description: Weapon offset from the character pivot, in pixels.
